payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over a fixed list of 12 precomputed one-move patterns, checking color equivalence with input via pairwise consistency.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks all possible cube states reachable in one rotation (12 patterns). It does not use backtracking, bitmasks, B&B, or graph traversal. The fixed list represents an enumeration of all move permutations, hence permutation_enumeration is the closest match.
